classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim protocol of a National Council debate, created at the time of the event by the Council.
classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary initiative debate recording from the Swiss National Council concerning the direct federal tax and taxation of auxiliary companies, captured during the winter session 2001. It features a single speaker, Liliane Maury Pasquier, and is part of the National Council's meeting protocols.
